name: Text to Image
intro: Welcome to Text to Image in SmartVideo. This page is a friendly menu for picking an image model or an example prompt before you head into Image Studio.

features.start-creating-free: The Start Creating Free button sits right under the banner. It opens Image Studio, so you can jump straight to the generator whenever you're ready.
features.why-choose-our-text-to-image-cards: These highlight cards sum up what Image Studio offers, including multiple ratios and high resolution. They're just for information, so you can skim them quickly.
features.available-models: Available Models is a grid of featured image models. Click a card and Image Studio opens with that model selected, so you skip searching the picker.
features.example-prompts: Example Prompts give you five proven starting points. Click Try this on one and Image Studio opens with the prompt filled in, ready for you to edit.
features.gtm-boost: GTM Boost helps you turn a rough marketing idea into a sharp prompt. Pick an angle, audience and goal, then apply it to send the prompt to Image Studio.
features.get-started-free: Down in the Ready to Create box, Get Started Free does the same job as the top button. Use it once you've browsed and found your starting point.

outro: That's the tour of Text to Image. Pick a model or a prompt, and you're one click from Image Studio.
